description.en: Toggles an engine-wide flag that prevents characters' base motion (their default idle/standing animation set) from being (re)loaded. Used to avoid animation pop/reload while an event script is manually driving character motions.
True to block base-motion loading, false to restore normal loading.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).
